fact: The December 2016 Implementation Strategy for the National ICT Policy 2016 covers 2016/17-2020/21 with a logframe of strategies, targets and indicators costed at TZS 248.2 billion, financed from Government budget, development partners and the private sector.
title: National Information and Communications Technology Policy 2016 Implementation Strategy 2016/17 - 2020/21
publisher: Ministry of Works, Transport and Communication
